torso_wire_cage.name: Wire Cage
torso_wire_cage.flavor: Mostly gaps. The gaps are the point.

torso_paper_husk.name: Paper Husk
torso_paper_husk.flavor: Barely there. Folds flat for storage.

torso_ribby.name: Ribby Torso
torso_ribby.flavor: The classic. You can count the mistakes.

torso_burst_seams.name: Burst Seams
torso_burst_seams.flavor: Everything is coming out. Everything is faster.

torso_inkwell.name: Inkwell Belly
torso_inkwell.flavor: Sloshes when you run. Ink likes it.

torso_stitched_sack.name: Stitched Sack
torso_stitched_sack.flavor: Someone sewed it shut. Someone was right to.

torso_barrel.name: Barrel Chest
torso_barrel.flavor: Drawn with the confidence of someone who has never seen a torso.

legs_dash_scratches.name: Dash Scratches
legs_dash_scratches.flavor: Drawn in one stroke, arriving before you do.

legs_tree_trunks.name: Tree Trunks
legs_tree_trunks.flavor: Bark included, at no extra charge.

arms_noodle_hookers.name: Noodle Hookers
arms_noodle_hookers.flavor: Wacky. Waving. You know the rest.

arms_scribble_whips.name: Scribble Whips
arms_scribble_whips.flavor: They arrive slightly before the rest of you.

arms_climber_claws.name: Climber Claws
arms_climber_claws.flavor: Ten crooked lines that really want to be fingers.

head_spit_gland.name: Spit Gland
head_spit_gland.flavor: Do not stand in front of it. Do not stand behind it.

head_monster_maw.name: Jagged Monster Maw
head_monster_maw.flavor: Every tooth a different size, on purpose, probably.

head_lantern_jaw.name: Lantern Jaw
head_lantern_jaw.flavor: Arrives at a room slightly before the rest of you.

head_two_faces.name: Two Bad Faces
head_two_faces.flavor: Neither of them is the good one.

head_bucket.name: Rusted Bucket
head_bucket.flavor: Not a head. Doing the job of a head.

tail_ink_dribble.name: Ink Dribble
tail_ink_dribble.flavor: Leaks constantly. Attracts its own kind.

tail_whip_line.name: Whip Line
tail_whip_line.flavor: One long line, drawn without lifting the pencil.

tail_scorpion.name: Scorpion Tail
tail_scorpion.flavor: The stinger was drawn first. Priorities.

tail_kick_spring.name: Kick Spring
tail_kick_spring.flavor: Kicks off the ground and off other people.

back_bat_scraps.name: Bat Wing Scraps
back_bat_scraps.flavor: Holes are aerodynamic if you believe.

back_kite_sail.name: Kite Sail
back_kite_sail.flavor: Catches wind that is not there.

back_ink_bladder.name: Ink Bladder
back_ink_bladder.flavor: Pressurised. Do not ask what with.

back_sketch_thrusters.name: Sketch Thrusters
back_sketch_thrusters.flavor: Two angry scribbles that emit smaller scribbles.

legs_front_scuttlers.name: Scuttler Forelegs
legs_front_scuttlers.flavor: Too many joints, all of them wrong. Very quick about it.

legs_front_reaching_arms.name: Reaching Arms
legs_front_reaching_arms.flavor: Front legs that never quite committed to being legs.

legs_front_dash_pads.name: Dash Pads
legs_front_dash_pads.flavor: Skid marks, drawn first, legs added after.

legs_front_shovel_claws.name: Shovel Claws
legs_front_shovel_claws.flavor: Digs in, gets low, stays low.

legs_front_paw_hammers.name: Paw Hammers
legs_front_paw_hammers.flavor: Drawn heavy, so they land heavy.

legs_rear_haunches.name: Spring Haunches
legs_rear_haunches.flavor: All the pounce lives back here.

legs_rear_glider_flaps.name: Glider Flaps
legs_rear_glider_flaps.flavor: Hind legs with opinions about air.

legs_rear_stiff_planks.name: Stiff Planks
legs_rear_stiff_planks.flavor: They do not bend. That is the whole design.

legs_rear_dragging_stumps.name: Dragging Stumps
legs_rear_dragging_stumps.flavor: They do not so much walk as get taken along.

legs_rear_ballast_sacks.name: Ballast Sacks
legs_rear_ballast_sacks.flavor: Keeps the back end on the ground where it belongs.
